BATHROOM REMODELING CONTRACTOR IN SOUTHEAST MICHIGAN

Designs in Glass has been one of the leading companies for bathroom remodeling contractors in Michigan for decades. Our professionals are highly experienced in major and minor bathroom renovation and design projects and we are certain that you will be 100% satisfied when selecting us to remodel your bathroom and/or shower room.

Our bathroom remodeling services include:

Custom bathroom design
complete bathroom refinishing
bathroom cabinets
bathroom countertops
bathroom vanities
glass shower doors
custom tubs
and more

Howard Emmer, Owner of Designs in Glass, is one of Michigan’s most talented and experienced bathroom remodeling contractors. With over 30 years of experience in the most extensive bathroom renovation projects possible, it is no wonder why Designs in Glass has been said to “set the standards that other remodeling companies follow“.

Designs in Glass has been Accredited by the Better Business Bureau with an A+ Rating for many consecutive years. We are proud to say that this, along with our great customer reviews, is what separates us from other bathroom remodeling companies in Michigan.

If you ask around your neighborhood; there is certain to be a family or two that has chosen our company for their bathroom Remodeling project and would be more than happy to refer you to our services.

PRODUCTS
Bathroom Countertops

Our custom bathroom countertops are the best. And they are made specific to your bathroom. Every time.

Bathroom Cabinets

There is no bathroom cabinet space or cabinet that we cannot design for you. This is a key part to your outcome.

Glass Shower Doors

Frameless and euro glass shower doors are what sets the bathroom apart from the rest of the house.

Bathroom Tiling & Lighting

From the floor to the ceiling. Our custom bathroom tiling and lighting will add the finishing touches to your bathroom.

THE BATHROOM RENOVATION COMPANY FOR YOU

We love helping our customers transform their ordinary bathroom into a fresh, beautifully designed showcase that friends and family will be talking about for years to come. We can design a new bathroom for you, or build the dream bathroom that you already have in mind.

Just about everything that we install for your project will be custom built to suit your specific space. Your renovated bathroom will be a unique work of art not found in any other home. When we are finished, you will be able to take a couple pictures and upload them to Pinterest so that others can be inspired with what a beautiful bathroom should look like.

Looking for a fresh look and custom cabinets for your kitchen or bathroom? Then you are in luck because we have some of the best cabinet installation contractors available! FLOOR TILES AND LIGHTING INSTALLATION IN SOUTHEAST MICHIGAN

From the floor to the ceiling, our custom floor tiles (and other flooring options) as well as lighting will add the finishing touches to your room that will leave family and guests in awe for many years. This is a very important part of your kitchen, bathroom, or any room design as there is not an appliance that is turned on more than a light and there is no surface that gets more use than the floor 🙂

Our custom flooring installation is top quality and includes everything from wood flooring, granite tiles (and other floor tiles). We can also design a nice custom backsplash to match or contour your floor tiling. Not only is the type of floor tiles that you select an important decision, so it the quality of the contractor that you hire to do the installation. Our 2 year warranty will make sure that your new floors stay fresh and new long after the initial installation.

Our custom lighting options are perfect for every room and situation. We can help you spice up your current living space by adding new lighting or pair them with a complete renovation project.

We can provide you with just about any type of lighting that you are looking for. Some of the most popular requests that we receive are for:

General kitchen and bathroom light fixtures
Recessed lighting
Ceiling lights
Track lighting

No matter what your situation, we are certain that we can match the perfect lighting option for you.

SOME OF OUR PREVIOUS WORK
CERAMIC TILES AND CUSTOM LIGHTING.

Take a look at some of the pictures above of previous tiling and lighting projects that we have completed. If you like what you see of have an idea in mind that you would like to know if we can install, we would love to hear from you and provide a free quote for your project.

Our free quote will be quick and easy. We can look through your living space with you, determine what would be a perfect match for what you are trying to accomplish and walk you through the installation process. If you are just upgrading your tiles and lighting, the installation will be pretty quick. We can also pair custom tiles and lighting with a complete renovation project.

Custom Countertops
GRANITE COUNTERTOP INSTALLATION IN SOUTHEAST MICHIGAN

Looking for a newly designs, custom countertop for your kitchen or bathroom? Then you are in luck because we have some of the best counter installation contractors available! We can install just about any type of countertop that you are looking for, though our most requested counters are granite countertops and quartz countertops.

There is no space in your home that we cannot custom design a countertop for. Whether it is a bathroom or kitchen counter, a kitchen island, cocktail bar, or seating nook, we are certain that we can handle your project and leave you 100% satisfied every step of the way.

What is the difference between granite and quartz countertops?

That is a great question and common among our customers and can be quite confusing due to their similarities in look. In short, granite countertops are cut from a solid piece of stone. And quartz countertops are manufactured from crushed quartz and bound together with a resin.

Both options have their side of the debate and will last you well over 25-30 years which makes them both a winner in our opinion. Granite seems to be more prone to chipping or cracking and required sealing and resealing periodically throughout the life of the countertop. Quartz is not free from chipping or cracking, but does not need to be sealed like granite.

SOME OF OUR PREVIOUS WORK
GRANITE COUNTERTOPS. CUSTOM FOR YOU!

Not many things will make your new bathroom or kitchen “pop” like fresh custom countertops. When we discuss your project with you and take a look at your room(s), we will help you understand the benefits of the types of countertops you are considering as well as how we would design them custom for your situation before installation.

We can also help you pick out the perfect hardware, sinks, and faucets should your project require these items. After we are completed with your project, we are certain that you will want to take many pictures and share them on Pinterest. And we would also understand why!

ABOUT US | DESIGNS IN GLASS
30 YEARS EXPERIENCE

We have over 30 years of experience in the kitchen & bathroom remodeling business.

BBB ACCREDITED

We are proudly accredited with the Better Business Bureau and maintain an outstanding A+ rating.

WE GOT HOWARD!

Howard Emmer (owner of Specialty Kitchens and Baths, LLC and Designs in Glass) is one of the leading names in the Michigan remodeling market.

“I love seeing my customers happy with the service we provide for them. Transforming parts of their home into beautifully remodeled areas is something that changes lives, and I am glad to be a part of that.”

-Howard Emmer, Owner of Designs in Glass

Specialty Kitchens and Baths, LLC (Designs in Glass) is a full service bathroom and kitchen remodeling company owned by Howard Emmer. Howard has been a leading name in the remodeling industry for over 30 Years and has become that name to trust when hiring a contractor.

Over the past few decades; we have satisfied many of your neighbors (and probably even your relatives) with our remodeling services. This reputation is what guarantees that you will have a positive experience when working with our company.

We do more than glass. We often find that homeowners mistake our company name and think that we only provide glass services. This is not true.

We are highly skilled in all of the following:

Bathroom Remodeling
Kitchen Remodeling
Glass Shower Doors
Granite Countertops
Custom Cabinets
Tiling & Lighting

OUR BATHROOM REMODEL PHOTO GALLERY

Take a moment to check out some of the bathroom and kitchen remodeling projects we have completed near you.

Kitchen Renovation in Novi
This beautiful kitchen renovation project that we installed in Novi Michigan features quality kitchen cabinets and countertops, along with hard wood flooring and recessed lighting.
Granite Countertops
These premium granite countertops were installed in a Bloomfield home along with some custom cabinets and gorgeous lighting fixtures.
Bathroom Remodeling Project
This bathroom remodeling project in Wixom MI features sleek modern cabinets and countertops and some contrasting floor tiles.
Glass Shower Door Installation
This is a custom glass shower door that we installed in Novi. What a great touch up to an already beautiful bathroom.
Cabinets and Countertop
Here is a beautiful combination of dark cabinets and granite countertop that we installed in South Lyon Michigan.
Before-and-After of a Bathroom
Here is a before and after bathroom remodeling project that we performed in Royal Oak. We can do the same for your bathroom!
Floor Tiles and Lighting
This is one perfect example of how great our floor tile and lighting installation services can bring your kitchen to life. This perfect kitchen renovation was performed in Birmingham Michigan.
Modern Kitchen Design
This modern kitchen that we designed and installed in Troy, MI is one of our favorites!
Comfortable Home Cooking
Nothing says home cooking like this country kitchen design that we installed in Farmington Hills. It is the perfect blend of cabinetry, lighting, countertops, and back-splash.
Custom Kitchen in Bloomfield
This high quality granite countertop was installed in a home in Bloomfield with a nice back-splash to add some pop to the kitchen.
Fine Glass Shower Door
Here is a perfect example of what our glass shower doors can do for your bathroom. This Novi home went with a modern style tub and beautiful shower enclosure.
Shower Tiles
Nothing spices up the shower of this Livonia home like some high quality wall tiling.
Glass Shower Enclosure
This is a full bathroom remodeling project that we performed in Rochester hills that features one of our favorite glass shower doors.
Partial Bathroom Makeover
This homeowner in Macomb Michigan wanted us to give them a new shower enclosure in their current bathroom. We called it a great success!

Write a review
Rebecca Fogg
2025-05-23
I cannot recommend Specialty Kitchens and Baths enough. They took our vision and transformed it into a stunning kitchen that truly exceeded our expectations. Our cooking space is not just beautiful, it’s now a sophisticated and efficient area that we love spending time in. Highly recommended them !!
Read more
Maha Komar
2024-01-28
I got a custom shower door order from design in glass for our shower. Great communication,
estimates, pricing and installation. Got it done in summer 2023. Very Professional. Highly recommend them.
Read more
Michael Gratson
2023-11-24
Did a great job on a tight timeline. Howard was very accommodating and worked well with us.
 
Ryan Doyle
2023-11-18
Howard and his team created a dreamy dreamy kitchen for us. We are in love with the final results. The process of working with him and his team was easy. They handled the entire thing from A to Z. When problems arose, they took control of the situation and led with transparency and solutions. I will 100% be hiring them again and I would absolutely recommend.
Read more
Marie Kaufman
2023-11-08
We are so happy with our bathroom (2) remodel. The crew was professional but personable. They helped us through design decisions and made recommendations that we are glad we followed. If anything went wrong (a given with this much work!), they were quick to make it right. Very accommodating when we decided to add scope in the middle. Looking forward to working with them on our next project.
Read more
Gordon Krainen
2023-08-06
I initially considered one of those bathroom remodel companies that go over the existing shower. I'm so glad I didn't. I could tell that they were high pressure and of only wanted to sell.
Howard Emmer came over and assessed the situation and did what I asked for. He used really great materials and was able to put a real tile floor over my existing one and replaced my worn out old glass with really high-quality glass with an invisible shield that helps prevent water stain. All at a reasonable price. The shower looks 1000 % better, is much more functional, and I know that it will only help with house resale in the future. I am extremely satisfied with our new shower.
Read more
Greg Stangis
2023-02-20
Howard and Bob were wonderful to work with. We did a complete bathroom renovation, down to the studs, and the entire process went smoothly and most importantly, on time.
Read more
shanna gillen
2022-12-11
I can’t say enough good things about my experience with Designs In Glass. From start to finish my experience was stellar. They communicated well throughout the whole process and were quick and professional. Also the pricing was fantastic. We love our glass shower door enclosure the quality is impeccable. Howard and Ken were both great to work with and the guys who installed were awesome as well. We will for sure recommend and use again in the future. Thank You!
Read more
Rosanne Siegal
2022-12-05
Working with Howard Emmer was a pleasure. Always a smile on his face and ready to help... he recommended our cabinetry provider and quality folks for any services they didn't directly provide. He was patient and supportive as scope and timeline expanded. I recommend his Howard and his team!
Read more
Maurita Plouff
2022-09-22
It was a gut-job bathroom remodel, average size bathroom. We love the result. They did exactly what they promised, with no fuss, and even fixed the bifold laundry doors that were sticking. They finished a bit ahead of schedule, and it's all beautiful.
Read more

I met Howard only to do a single shower door and once I found out his company does all renovations inside we signed contract to do 2 of my bathrooms for complete makeover. I let him in on my vision and he found all the fixtures for the house and did a great job. Howard was full of ideas and helped with design to accomplish turning my entire house into my forever home. I have referred many of my friends and all have had same experience with Howard/ Bob and entire crew.
Veena K.
Rochester Hills, MI

Designs in Glass/Specialty Kitchen and Bath redid my entire condo and fulfilled all my wishes to the letter. It was a major makeover throughout entire condo, new kitchen , bathrooms, custom flooring and finish paint. I am so pleased to find Howard and his company and recommend to all my friends and family. Thank you thank you Custom service is alive and well with companies like his.
Anthony P.
Bloomfield Hills, MI

I had you remodel both my bathrooms as soon as I talked to some of your references I needed to get a hold of you to get these project done in timely manner. Once agreed on spec/design and I decided to supply all material the projects came out great. Thanks again Howard, enjoy the dream cruise. My corvette is still for sale???
David R.
Warren, MI

Once your company and yourself provided us with a great bathroom and family room renovation few years ago, both my wife and I knew you would be our only choice for a very special master bathroom makeover. All your help and guidance for us to find all the materials we wanted to select, the major makeover went like clockwork to a finish product that is so beautiful and everything we could ask for.
Paer and Ninna M.
Bloomfield Hills, MI

Howard just wanted to thank you where most contractors were not interested in such a small job with such a small bathroom, you took on our project and did exactly what we needed and in a budget we could afford. Thanks again.
Chuck and Donna W.
Garden City, MI

We love our new bathroom renovation and look forward when we ready for our next project. Howard, your our first and only phone call after this project went so professionally.
Darryl and Linda D.
Macomb, MI

Though we had little language barrier we all were able to complete my major kitchen/living room makeover and make everyone happy in the family. It was a lot of detail, especially me being an engineer, but everything and every detail was done to perfection. Thanks again Howard, Bob and your crew.
Atsumasa K.
Northville, MI

I had another contractor do a handyman special and did an awful job, then I was referred to Howard, owner of Designs in Glass/ Specialty Kitchen and Bath. Wow, what a difference. Howard went over every detail and explained have to gut out again and do everything properly. I watched daily for 2 weeks how much work this job really entailed from gut, to rough plumbing, cement board, red guard waterproof then finish tile. I love my bathroom and I will refer Howard and his crews to all my friends and family.
Claude M.
Oak Park, MI

We found a great contractor with Howard , Designs in Glass/Specialty Kitchen and Bath. We wanted to supply all materials and just have our contractor do labor only, but not many wanted that scenario. Howard and his crews were professional, on time and Howard did great job communicating during the whole process of doing both our bathrooms. He even told us don’t be alarmed if I stop by everyday to see progress, even though he did’nt have to, but always came with a smile and helpful advice.
Dimitry H.
Novi, MI

Howard, you made it so nice and easy for our live in mother-inlaw, the bathroom made life so much better for all. Thank you for your help and guidance through this whole custom bathroom project.
John and Sandy H.
Rochester, MI

I loved the bathrooms you did for my friends and after they gave me your number I jumped at the chance get you and the team to help with my old bathroom of over 50 years old. After complete gut out, the bathroom is beautiful and the whole process was easier than I thought though you did say from start to finish it would be at least 3-4 weeks to complete. It was 3 1/2 weeks and pleasure seeing you and your crews do a great job from start to finish.
Melanie Z.
Royal Oak, MI

I got a custom shower door order from design in glass for our shower. Great communication, estimates, pricing and installation. Got it done in summer 2023. Very Professional. Highly recommend them.
Maha Komar

Want a free quote for your next kitchen or bathroom remodeling project? We love talking about this stuff with our customers and would be happy to help you build your dream room.

Request a Quote Now
KITCHEN/BATHROOM REMODELING AND GLASS SHOWER DOORS IN NORTHVILLE MI

You’re probably looking for a remodeling contractor for your kitchen/bathroom or to install a glass shower door. Well today is your lucky day!

WHAT MAKES US THE BEST?

When you ask yourself -or Google- “what are the best bathroom and kitchen remodeling companies near Northville” what are you really looking for? The best price? The best reputation? The highest quality products? Fast turn-around of service? Of course you want all of these packaged together and that is exactly what we strive to bring to you every time.

GUARANTEED SATISFACTION.

While we may not be the lowest price you receive –every time– there is no better bathroom or kitchen remodeling contractor in Northville Michigan than Designs in Glass. Not just because we say so (every other remodeling contractor says that same thing right?). But because our quality products/services, satisfied customers and proven reputation say so.

OUR REMODELING PRODUCTS & SERVICES

We offer a wide variety of kitchen and bathroom remodeling products/services in Northville. Click on one below to learn more.

Bathroom Remodeling

Our bathroom remodeling services include complete makeover/renovations, bathroom cabinets, countertops, glass shower doors, flooring/tiles and lighting.

Kitchen Remodeling

Our kitchen remodeling services include complete makeover/renovations, kitchen design, kitchen cabinets, countertops, islands and bars, flooring/tiles and lighting.

Glass Shower Doors

Our glass shower door services include frameless and seamless glass shower doors, euro shower doors, custom shower stalls and sliding shower doors.

Custom Countertops

Our custom granite and quartz countertops are the best. There is no part of your home where we cannot design and install a countertop for.

Custom Cabinets

Our custom cabinet installation service can meet the expectations of any homeowner. We can design and install kitchen cabinets, bathroom cabinets, pantry cabinets and more…

Tiles and Lighting

Our flooring and lighting services include: wood flooring, floor tiles, ceramic tiles, recessed lighting, track lighting, bright lights, night lights and much more.

Q & A FROM OUR NORTHVILLE CUSTOMERS

Below is a list of some frequently asked questions that we receive from our customers in Northville Michigan.

Q: What warranty do you provide?

A: In addition to the standard manufacturer’s warranties on our products, we provide a two (2) year workmanship warranty on all installations that we perform.

Q: How long will my remodeling project take?

A: The timing of any remodeling project will vary depending on the services provided. Typically, a full kitchen/bathroom remodeling project may take 2-4 weeks. Glass shower door installations will take apx 10 days.

Q: What is the difference between granite and quartz countertops?

A: In short, granite is a solid piece of stone that is slightly more cost effective, requires maintenance, and is more prone to chipping/cracking. Quartz is made of crushed quartz and less prone to cracking/chipping.

Meet The Owners

Your Renovation Team

Lorna McCartney

PROJECT MANAGER + DESIGNER

Lorna has been passionate about design since renovating her own first home in 2006. 

Once a dedicated nurse practitioner, Lorna decided to embark on a new chapter in her life to follow her heart's calling. Her transition from the medical field to renovation and design was driven by a desire to create spaces that inspire and uplift the human spirit. 

Lorna's design philosophy is rooted in her love of clean, efficient spaces coupled with serene colorways and laid-back vibes of the coastline. As a mother of two, she understands the importance of creating spaces that are not only beautiful but functional for families. She prides herself in her attention to detail and commitment to quality and believes that every space should reflect a homeowner’s personality and lifestyle. 

Mel Kelly

GENERAL CONTRACTOR + DESIGNER

Mel is a contemporary artist turned interior designer & General Contractor here in the Kansas City area. Mel’s passion for design burst into life back in 2011 as she and her husband remodeled their first home. Through that process she began creating custom artwork and eventually selling art for interiors from Maui to NYC.

She strengthened her design portfolio through running her own home decor business (Not Boring Home) from 2019-2022. Her work for Not Boring Home landed her shop in The World of Interiors and House & Garden Magazine. 

Now she brings that passion for art and contemporary design to your home. Mel’s personal mission is to help turn your space into a haven where you can be yourself and live your best life.

We’re Featured on Redfin! Bathroom Tips Before Selling
Sep 16 
Written By Mel Kelly

We’re excited to share that Haven Reno KC was recently featured by Redfin in their article “9 Ways to Get Your Bathrooms Open-House Ready.”

Redfin asked home and remodeling professionals what homeowners should prioritize when preparing a bathroom for an open house, including which small improvements make the strongest impression and which updates may not be worth the investment before selling.

We shared a few of the things we notice all the time in bathrooms around Lee’s Summit and the Kansas City area.

And the good news? Most of them don’t require a remodel.

Before Selling, Focus on “Clean and Cared For”

If you’re planning to sell your home soon, a dated bathroom doesn’t necessarily mean you should remodel it.

In fact, we shared with Redfin:

“Even if your bathroom looks a little sad, it’s unlikely you’ll get a return on your investment with a full remodel. Priority wise, you’ll get a much better return with fresh paint on your walls, trim and ideally your ceiling too. If budget allows, an updated light fixture also makes a great investment. Peeling, moldy caulk and stained grout are two small details that can gross out buyers in an instant, but fresh caulk and grout cleaning are such easy, inexpensive fixes, especially compared to a remodel.”

The goal before an open house should usually be to make the bathroom feel clean, bright, maintained and move-in ready, rather than trying to completely transform it.

Here are a few of the smaller updates we recommend.

1. Make Sure Your Light Bulbs Match

This may be one of the easiest bathroom improvements people overlook.

Make sure every bulb in the bathroom matches in both style and color temperature.

If one bulb is warm yellow, another is bright white and another has a bluish cast, the entire bathroom can feel disjointed, even when buyers can’t immediately explain why.

For our bathroom remodeling projects, we typically use 3000K lighting.

It gives bathrooms a nice balance: bright and clean without feeling overly harsh or clinical, but not so warm that everything starts looking yellow.

Lighting affects how buyers see your paint colors, countertops, tile, cabinetry and even how clean the room appears. Before spending money replacing larger finishes, start by making sure the lighting is working in your favor.

2. Freshen Up Your Paint

Fresh paint is one of the most cost-effective ways to make a bathroom feel cared for.

Look beyond just the walls.

Check the:

Walls

Baseboards and trim

Doors

Ceiling

Bathrooms are especially prone to scuffs, moisture staining and dingy ceilings.

If the room needs a refresh, a clean coat of paint can make a surprisingly big difference without requiring a major renovation.

If you need inspiration, we’ve also put together some of our favorite neutral paint colors that work beautifully in homes around the Kansas City area.

3. Replace an Outdated Vanity Light if the Budget Allows

If you have a little more room in the budget, take a look at the vanity light.

Lighting fixtures tend to visually date a bathroom very quickly.

Replacing an older fixture with something clean and current can modernize the entire vanity wall without replacing the vanity, countertop or mirror.

And because lighting has such a major impact on how a space feels, this is one area where a relatively small investment can have an outsized visual effect.

4. Replace Peeling or Moldy Caulk

Nothing screams “there might be a maintenance problem here” quite like peeling, moldy or badly discolored caulk.

Fortunately, this is also one of the least expensive things to fix.

Fresh caulk around the shower, tub and countertop can immediately make a bathroom feel cleaner and better maintained.

The same goes for grout.

If your grout is dark or stained, a good grout cleaning can make existing tile look dramatically better without replacing any of it.

5. Clean the Shower Glass

Glass shower doors show water spots, mineral buildup and soap residue very easily, especially when sunlight or bathroom lighting hits the glass.

If you have glass shower doors, give them some extra attention before listing photos or an open house.

We actually wrote an entire guide on how to keep glass shower doors sparkling clean, including the simple maintenance routine we recommend to our remodeling clients.

6. Make Your Hardware Feel Intentional

Look around the room at your:

Cabinet hardware

Towel bars

Toilet paper holder

Faucets

Shower hardware

Light fixture

Everything does not necessarily have to be identical, but the finishes should look intentional.

If the room has an assortment of bright chrome, brushed nickel, oil-rubbed bronze and gold that accumulated through years of individual repairs, simplifying some of those finishes can help the room feel more cohesive.

You don’t need to replace every plumbing fixture to accomplish this.

Sometimes swapping cabinet hardware or accessories is enough.

Should You Remodel a Bathroom Before Selling?

Usually, we wouldn’t recommend starting a full bathroom remodel solely because you’re preparing to list your home.

If the bathroom functions properly but simply looks dated, smaller cosmetic improvements are often the more practical choice.

But that’s very different from remodeling a bathroom because you plan to stay in the home and want it to work better for your family.

That’s when larger improvements like a new layout, custom cabinetry, better storage, improved lighting, updated tile or a larger shower can make a lot more sense.

For example, take a look at our Lee’s Summit Spa Bathroom Remodel before and after to see how dramatically a dated primary bathroom can change when the goal is creating a space homeowners will actually enjoy living in.

We also completed a green bathroom remodel in Lee’s Summit that shows how color, tile, lighting and thoughtful storage can completely change the feeling of a smaller bathroom.

Read Our Feature on Redfin

Thank you to Amanda Tripp and Redfin for including Haven Reno KC in this article and allowing us to share our perspective.

You can read the full article here:

“9 Ways to Get Your Bathrooms Open-House Ready” on Redfin.

The article was written by Amanda Tripp and originally published by Redfin on September 16, 2026.

Planning a Bathroom Remodel in Lee’s Summit?

If you’re staying in your home and your bathroom isn’t working for you anymore, that’s a different conversation.

At Haven Reno KC, we help homeowners in Lee’s Summit and surrounding communities create bathrooms that are beautiful, functional and comfortable to live with every day.

We can help with everything from layout and cabinetry to tile, countertops, paint colors, lighting and the finishing details that pull the space together.

Ready to start planning your bathroom remodel? Contact Haven Reno KC to schedule an estimate.

How It Works
Three simple steps to your stunning new bathroom — and your complimentary $1,000 upgrade package.

Schedule Your Free Consultation

Fill out the form above or call us. We'll schedule a no-obligation, no-pressure in-home estimate at a time that works for you.

We are not a big franchise. We are your neighbors — and we treat your home like our own.

Every project we complete is backed by our lifetime workmanship guarantee. We stand behind our work — period.

Done In As Little As One Day — Guaranteed

No weeks of construction. No living without your bathroom. We complete most remodels in a single day — and we back that with our satisfaction guarantee.

Fair, Upfront Pricing

No gimmicks. No bait-and-switch. We give you a clear, honest price before any work begins — and we stick to it.

Premium Samuel Mueller Materials

We use top-of-the-line solid surface materials that resist mold, staining, and wear — and look beautiful for years.

Get the bathroom you deserve now. We offer flexible financing options to fit your budget, including low monthly payment plans.

A bathroom can feel outdated fast when walls are hard to clean, moisture builds up in corners, or finishes no longer match the rest of the space. Many homeowners notice that even after replacing fixtures or repainting, something still feels unfinished. That missing detail is often the wall surface behind sinks and vanities, areas that take constant splash and steam and show wear first.

Bathroom backsplash installation focuses on wall protection and design behind sinks, vanities, and accent areas. It does not involve full shower wall systems unless specifically requested, making it an efficient upgrade without the scope or cost of a full remodel.

With more than 10 years of hands-on experience, Your New Baths helps homeowners turn overlooked wall areas into polished design features using premium materials, fair pricing, and a workmanship guarantee that protects your investment long after the project is complete. What Problems Does A Bathroom Backsplash Installation Solve?

Moisture damage is one of the most common problems in bathrooms, especially in older homes. Painted drywall behind sinks and counters often stains, peels, or grows mold over time because it simply isn’t designed to handle constant water exposure. A professionally completed backsplash protects those vulnerable surfaces while creating a finished look that ties the room together.

Water splashing from sinks, steam from showers, and humidity from daily use all take their toll on unprotected walls. Without proper protection, homeowners end up repainting, patching damage, or discovering mold issues that require more involved repairs. A backsplash creates a durable barrier where it matters most.

Backsplashes also solve the “almost finished” problem. Even new fixtures can look out of place when the walls behind the vanity feel blank, worn, or mismatched. A well-planned backsplash adds contrast, texture, and definition, without overwhelming the space.

And day to day, it makes cleaning easier. Instead of scrubbing painted walls that absorb moisture and stains, you can wipe down a smooth surface in seconds. For boardman homeowners, this is one of the best value-for-money upgrades because the visual impact is big, the disruption is small, and the benefit is immediate.

CALL US NOW
How Your New Baths Delivers Better Results

Every project begins with listening first. You’ll get guidance on material selection, layout, height, and spacing so the backsplash complements your existing vanity, mirror, lighting, and fixtures, rather than competing with them. The goal is a result that feels intentional and balanced.

Our installation process emphasizes cleanliness, precision, and reasonable speed. We protect surrounding areas, prep surfaces properly, and focus on the details that make the finished work look professional up close: straight lines, clean edges, tight transitions, and proper sealing where moisture exposure is highest.

Material selection is based on real bathroom performance: moisture resistance, easy maintenance, and long-term durability. Tile remains a great choice for many homeowners, especially when you want pattern, texture, or a classic look. 

Tile remains the most popular backsplash option for bathrooms, especially for homeowners who want color, pattern, or texture that complements existing finishes. For homeowners who want a sleek finish with minimal maintenance, Samuel Mueller solid surface can also work beautifully in backsplash applications. 

Homeowners choosing professional backsplash installation in boardman also benefit from fair, transparent pricing, flexible financing options, and a workmanship guarantee that reflects confidence in the finished result.

CALL US NOW
Design Options That Match Your Style

Most homeowners choose a backsplash style based on how much wall protection they want and how bold they want the visual impact to be. Backsplashes can be subtle or bold, it depends on your space and your goals.

Standard-height backsplashes (4–6 inches): Simple protection where water splashes most, with a classic look.
Full-height vanity backsplashes: Extend to the mirror or higher for maximum protection and a more finished, high-end feel.
Accent backsplashes: Use contrast or pattern to create a focal point without changing the rest of the bathroom.
Coordinated finishes: Match or complement existing countertops, floors, or fixtures for a cohesive look.

Your New Baths helps you choose an approach that fits your bathroom, your style, and your budget, without pushing you toward the most expensive option.

CALL US NOW
The Installation Process: What To Expect

Most projects follow a clear, predictable process. First, we protect your bathroom and prep the wall surface so it’s clean, dry, and ready for proper adhesion. If we find damage beneath old paint or materials, we address it before installing anything new. It’s always better to fix issues now than cover them up.

Next, materials are measured and cut to fit your space. Corners, edges, and transitions are custom-fitted so the backsplash looks clean and deliberate. Finally, everything is installed using bathroom-rated adhesives and sealed correctly to prevent water infiltration. In most cases, the work moves efficiently with minimal disruption, and you’ll know what to expect throughout the process.

Skipping proper surface prep or sealing is the most common reason backsplash installations fail prematurely, which is why these steps are never rushed or skipped.

CALL US NOW
Common Mistakes To Avoid

Backsplashes fail when corners are cut. The most common issues include skipping surface prep, using the wrong adhesive or sealant for moisture exposure, poor layout planning that leads to awkward cuts, and unfinished edges that make the entire project look cheap. Professional installation avoids these mistakes by treating prep, layout, waterproofing, and finishing details as non-negotiable.

Shower Materials That Hold Up Long-Term

Choosing the right shower materials makes all the difference. Low-grade acrylic or fiberglass surrounds crack, stain, and fade quickly. Tile showers require constant grout maintenance and often fail at seams over time. Even with diligent sealing and cleaning, tile showers show their age faster than homeowners expect.

Samuel Mueller solid surface shower systems are durable, non-porous, and built to last. They resist moisture, prevent mold growth, and stay looking new with basic cleaning. The solid construction means the color goes all the way through the material: minor scratches can be buffed out rather than showing as permanent damage.

The non-porous nature of solid surface materials is particularly important in shower applications. Water cannot penetrate the surface, which means no trapped moisture, no hidden mold growth, and no deterioration from within. This also makes cleaning remarkably simple, soap scum and mineral deposits wipe away easily.

Your New Baths helps Boardman homeowners choose materials that balance cost, durability, and long-term performance, not just what looks good on installation day. We install fixtures designed for years of daily use, with solid brass construction, ceramic disc valves, and finishes that resist corrosion.

Shower bases deserve particular attention. A properly installed shower pan with adequate slope ensures complete drainage, prevents standing water, and eliminates the musty smell that comes from water pooling in low spots. 

CALL US NOW
Common Shower Installation Mistakes To Avoid

The biggest mistake homeowners make is choosing the lowest bid without understanding what’s included or excluded. Poor installation leads to leaks, mold, and costly repairs that dwarf any initial savings. Waterproofing, proper drainage, and correct wall preparation are non-negotiable elements of a lasting shower installation.

Inadequate waterproofing is the most common installation failure. Water finds every gap, seam, and penetration, working its way behind walls and under flooring. Professional installers create redundant waterproofing layers, seal all penetrations properly, and test their work before closing up walls.

Another common issue is ignoring ventilation. Without proper airflow, even the best shower materials won’t perform as intended. Moisture accumulates in the bathroom, leading to mildew on walls and ceilings, peeling paint, and deterioration of materials.

Improper slope in the shower base causes water to pool instead of draining completely. This creates slip hazards, leaves standing water that breeds bacteria, and contributes to musty odors. Professional installation includes proper sloping, adequate drain sizing, and testing to ensure complete drainage.

Your New Baths ensures every shower installation is done correctly from the inside out, protecting your home and your investment. 

CALL US NOW

We start by protecting your home with floor coverings and dust barriers, then carefully remove your existing shower or tub. Once exposed, we inspect for hidden water damage and address any issues before moving forward. If we find problems, we discuss them with you and provide clear pricing before doing any additional work.

Next comes waterproofing, base installation, wall panels, fixtures, and finishing details. We prepare surfaces, apply waterproof membranes, and create a moisture barrier that will protect your home for decades. The shower base must be level while sloping toward the drain at the correct angle.

Wall panel installation follows, with each panel carefully positioned, secured, and sealed. Fixtures are installed and tested, ensuring everything functions correctly. We check water pressure, verify proper temperature control, test drainage, and make any necessary adjustments.

For many Boardman homeowners, the entire shower installation is completed in one day, with the shower ready to use that evening. For larger projects, we keep you informed every step of the way.

Many families find that once children outgrow bath time, the tub becomes wasted space. A well-designed walk-in shower can feel significantly more spacious while offering all the functionality you actually need.

Shower replacement installations work well when the layout is functional but the materials are worn, stained, or outdated. New wall panels, a reinforced shower base, updated fixtures, and modern glass can completely transform the space without relocating plumbing. This approach typically offers the fastest turnaround since we’re working within the existing footprint.

The right shower installation is about matching the solution to how you actually live, not pushing unnecessary upgrades.

What Problems Does A Shower Remodel Actually Solve?

Old showers don’t just look dated, many start to feel like a constant chore that you dread. If you’re scrubbing the same spots again and again, fighting mildew in grout lines that won’t come clean, or dealing with surfaces that never look bright no matter how hard you work, those shower issues slowly wear on comfort, cleanliness, and peace of mind adds up.

Mold and mildew aren’t just unsightly, they’re genuine health concerns. They affect indoor air quality, trigger allergies and respiratory issues, and indicate moisture problems that could be causing hidden damage behind your walls. When water seeps through deteriorating caulk or cracked grout, it creates problems you can’t see until they become expensive disasters.

Some showers also stop working for the way you live now. Maybe the step-in height is awkward and difficult to navigate. Maybe there’s nowhere to store your toiletries and everything’s always falling over. Maybe the layout feels tight and you can barely turn around without bumping into walls. The right update can make the room feel bigger, safer, and easier to use with a smart remodel that fits your routine.

And when you’re worried about mess, disruption, or surprise costs, it’s easy to delay the project indefinitely. In reality, a smoother experience starts with clear expectations and proper planning, especially for busy homeowners in boardman who want an upgrade that feels simple and straightforward from start to finish.

The bottom line? Your shower should be a place where you feel refreshed and ready for the day, not frustrated and uncomfortable before you’ve even gotten dressed.

How Your New Baths Does It Better

A great result starts with a simple, transparent process. You’ll talk through your goals, your budget, and what you want the finished space to feel like, so the work stays focused and the choices stay manageable instead of overwhelming.

At Your New Baths, we specialize in one-day showers and full bathroom transformations using premium Samuel Mueller solid surface materials. What makes us different is our commitment to communication and personalized customer experiences. We value honesty, care, and quality workmanship, and we back it up with guarantees you can trust. When you’re investing in something you use every single day, that commitment matters.

When homeowners want speed without cutting corners or compromising quality, we plan for clean work habits, careful preparation, and tight finishing details, especially when one-day remodels are the right fit for the project scope. We’ve refined our process through years of experience to deliver exceptional results efficiently.

Samuel Mueller solid surface materials are ideal for shower remodeling in Boardman﻿, OH. Unlike traditional tile with grout lines that trap moisture and require endless maintenance, solid surface installations are seamlessly integrated, completely non-porous, and incredibly easy to keep clean with just a quick wipe-down.

These premium materials naturally resist mold, mildew, and bacteria becausebecause there are no seams or porous areas where moisture can collect or spread. They’re also remarkably durable, standing up to daily use without cracking, chipping, fading, or showing wear over time. For homeowners who want a high-end look with genuinely low-maintenance upkeep, it’s the perfect solution.

You’ll also get straightforward options that keep the project comfortable financially, including flexible financing that helps you move forward without putting life on pause or draining your savings. We believe in honest conversations about investment and value.

Why Samuel Mueller Materials Transform Your Shower Experience

﻿Let’s talk honestly about materials, because this choice dramatically affects your satisfaction for years to come. Traditional tile might look beautiful initially, but it comes with significant maintenance burdens that most homeowners underestimate.

Grout lines require regular sealing to prevent moisture penetration. They need constant scrubbing to remove mildew and soap scum. Eventually, they need to be completely regrouted, which is expensive and time-consuming. It’s a maintenance cycle that literally never ends.

Samuel Mueller solid surface materials eliminate these problems entirely. The seamless installation means no grout lines, no seams where water can penetrate, and no areas where mold and mildew can take hold and grow. The surface is completely non-porous, so nothing absorbs into the material.

Cleaning becomes dramatically easier after a shower remodel with a solid surface. Instead of scrubbing grout lines with specialized cleaners, brushes, and significant elbow grease, you simply wipe down smooth surfaces with regular bathroom cleaner. It takes minutes instead of hours, and your shower stays looking fresh without constant effort.

Durability is another major advantage for Boardman homeowners. These materials resist impact damage, don’t chip or crack like tile, and maintain their color and finish for decades without fading or yellowing. You’re not dealing with cracked tiles, missing grout, or surfaces that progressively deteriorate over time.

The installation process is also more reliable. With fewer seams and joints, there are fewer potential failure points where leaks can develop. This means better long-term protection for your home’s structure and peace of mind for you.

One-Day Shower Remodels: Speed Without Compromise

﻿Here’s what homeowners love about one-day shower remodels: minimal disruption to your life, faster results that let you get back to normal immediately, and avoiding weeks of living without a functional bathroom or dealing with construction mess throughout your home.

Our streamlined process works because we’ve refined every step through years of hands-on experienceWe arrive fully prepared with all materials and tools, protect your home with proper coverings and containment systems, and work efficiently and professionally throughout the day. And we clean up completely before we leave, hauling away all debris.

One-day remodeling works particularly well for shower replacements where we’re not moving plumbing, making major structural changes, or dealing with extensive water damage that requires additional repairs. The existing footprint stays the same, we’re just upgrading what’s there with superior materials and modern design.

This doesn’t mean rushed work, shortcuts, or compromised quality. It means experienced installers who know exactly what they’re doing, premium materials specifically designed for efficient installation, and a proven process that delivers professional results in condensed timeframes without sacrificing craftsmanship or durability.

For boardman homeowners who can’t afford to have their bathroom out of commission for weeks, who work from home, or who just value convenience and minimal disruption, this approach genuinely changes everything about the remodeling experience.

Common Shower Remodeling Mistakes To Avoid
﻿Lowest Bid

Here’s what trips up most homeowners: choosing a contractor based solely on the lowest bid without checking references, work quality, or credentials. That “unbeatable price” often becomes a nightmare of water damage, poor workmanship, callbacks, and ultimately paying twice to get it fixed properly.

Inadequate Waterproofing

Inadequate waterproofing is perhaps the most expensive mistake possible in any shower remodel. Proper waterproofing behind walls and under the base prevents catastrophic water damage that can cost tens of thousands to repair. Contractors who skip or shortcut this critical step arecreating serious long-term risks hidden behind the walls.

Poor Ventilation

Ignoring proper ventilation leads to persistent moisture problems, mold growth, and premature material failure. A quality exhaust fan properly sized for your bathroom space isn’t optional or negotiable, it’s essential for protecting your investment.

Poor Planning

Poor planning around accessibility and future needs creates problems down the road. Even if you don’t need accessibility features today, incorporating them during your remodel is exponentially easier and cheaper than trying to retrofit later when needs change.

Low-Quality Materials

Using cheap materials to save money upfront almost always costs substantially more over time. Low-quality acrylic cracks and stains within months. Thin fiberglass flexes, develops stress cracks, and eventually leaks. Builder-grade fixtures break and need frequent replacement. Quality materials cost more initially but deliver better value over their lifespan.

Your New Baths helps Boardman homeowners avoid these common and costly pitfalls by providing experienced guidance, quality materials that last, and proper installation techniques that protect your investment for decades.

Budgeting Smart For Your Shower Remodel

﻿Understanding costs upfront helps homeowners make smarter decisions and avoid surprises about shower remodeling projects. Size matters significantly. A compact corner shower costs substantially less than a large walk-in design with extensive wall coverage. The amount of material and labor required scales directly with project size.

Material quality affects both upfront cost and long-term value. Premium materials like Samuel Mueller solid surface cost more initially but require dramatically less maintenance, last considerably longer, and provide superior performance. Cheap materials seem attractive until you’re replacing them in just a few years.

Complexity of work impacts pricing considerably. A straightforward replacement using existing plumbing and layout is less expensive than relocating drains, moving walls, adding electrical outlets, or repairing extensive water damage discovered during demolition.

Labor represents a major cost component, and here’s why it matters: skilled installers charge professional rates because they work efficiently, make fewer mistakes, and deliver results that last. Cheap labor typically means callbacks, corrections, frustration, and ultimately higher total costs.

Your New Baths provides transparent pricing from the initial consultation. We break down exactly what you’re paying for, so there’s no confusion, no hidden fees tucked into fine print, and no surprise charges that appear halfway through the project.

Flexible financing makes quality work accessible to more homeowners. Instead of waiting years to accumulate sufficient cash savings, financing options let you move forward now and pay over time, so you start enjoying your improved shower immediately instead of continuing to suffer with a space that doesn’t work.﻿﻿

Design-Build Remodeling in Scottsdale, AZ
REQUEST CONSULTATION
Remodeling Homes Across Scottsdale With Precision And Purpose

Scottsdale homes reflect a wide range of architectural styles; from contemporary desert builds to established custom residences. Remodeling in this environment requires attention to detail, cohesive design planning, and material selections that elevate the entire home.

At Premier Design-Build-Remodel, we guide Scottsdale homeowners through a structured design-build process that aligns vision with execution. Every remodel is planned with intention; ensuring layout, finishes, and structural updates work together seamlessly.

When remodeling is approached comprehensively, the result feels elevated rather than incremental.

Remodeling Services We Offer In Scottsdale

Our Scottsdale team provides full-service residential remodeling, including:

Kitchen Remodeling in Scottsdale
Custom layouts, premium cabinetry, structural reconfiguration, and high-performance appliance integration.
Bathroom Remodeling in Scottsdale
Spa-inspired primary suites, luxury finishes, and precision tile craftsmanship.
Whole Home Remodeling in Scottsdale
Cohesive transformations that unify architecture, materials, and systems.
Casitas & Home Additions in Scottsdale
Detached guest homes, expansions, and structural additions designed for seamless integration.

Each project follows our structured 6-step design-build model; creating clarity before construction begins.

Visit Our Scottsdale Showroom

Remodeling at a higher level requires informed material selection.

At our Scottsdale showroom, homeowners can explore:

Custom cabinetry displays
Premium countertop materials
Designer tile collections
Lighting installations
Plumbing fixtures and hardware
Coordinated finish palettes

Meeting with our design team in person allows you to compare materials, evaluate combinations, and move into the planning phase with confidence.

Seeing and touching materials firsthand transforms decisions from theoretical to intentional.

Why Scottsdale Homeowners Choose Premier

Remodeling in Scottsdale often involves higher customization, detailed finish work, and architectural coordination.

Homeowners choose Premier because we provide:

A fully integrated design-build structure
Defined scope before construction
Structured communication and scheduling
Experience with city permitting requirements
Showroom-based material selection support

By managing design and construction under one accountable team, we maintain alignment from concept to completion.

Our 6-Step Remodeling Process In Scottsdale
Complimentary Consultation
Meet with our design team in the Scottsdale showroom to discuss vision, layout possibilities, and next steps.
Discovery & Measurement
In-home evaluation, measurements, and documentation to refine scope.
Design & Renderings
Detailed drawings, renderings, and curated material selections for your Scottsdale home.
Contract Signing
Scope, scheduling, and pricing alignment before construction begins.
Construction Work
Coordinated build phase with structured oversight and quality control.
Project Completion
Final walkthrough and continued support.

WHO WE ARE
Decades of Remodeling Excellence in Arizona
Meet Our Team
A dedicated design-build team serving homeowners across the Phoenix metro area.
Greg Heden
President
Greg Heden is the visionary leader behind Premier Design-Build-Remodel. Since founding the company in 1994, Greg has earned a reputation for excellence by blending innovative design, superior craftsmanship, and expert project management.
Kent Redmond
VP Production & Operations
Kent Redmond’s 33-year career in residential project management is defined by his exceptional leadership, problem-solving, and high-level communication. He has a proven track record of successfully managing a wide range of residential projects.
Kym Davis
VP Sales & Design
Kym still maintains his passion for residential remodeling after 45 years because it revolves around families adapting their homes to fit their lifestyles. As he’s gotten older, his talents and interests have evolved from the “designer” role to “mentor.
Stephanie Olesen-Bute, NCIDQ
Interior Designer
Originally from the Midwest, Stephanie holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts in Interior Design from the Illinois Institute of Art–Chicago. A nationally certified NCIDQ designer with over 25 years’ experience, she creates functional, client-reflective spaces, drawing inspiration from travel, yoga, and Pilates.
Rachel Herrera
Design Consultant
Rachel dedicated years to learning the tile installation trade and eventually grew her team as word of her skills spread quickly. Her business flourished with the support of local homeowners, and she built a remodeling business with a focus on tile design.
Chris Ebert
Design Consultant
Chris brings over 35 years of experience to the design industry, where his journey began in the creative hub of Chicago, Illinois. With a personalized approach to each project, Chris ensures that every client achieves a unique and tailored space to call their own.
Julian Barabash
Project Development Advisor
Julian is a trusted advisor known for discretion, discernment, and unwavering client focus. He brings clarity to complex decisions, offering guidance rather than influence, so clients move forward with confidence. Built on trust and transparency, his approach ensures every decision is thoughtful, deliberate, and rooted in lasting peace of mind.

OUR PROCESS
Decades of Remodeling Excellence in Arizona
Complimentary Design Consultation

Your journey begins with a personalized one-hour consultation, typically held in our showroom, where inspiration comes to life. During this meeting, you’ll meet with one of our designers to help us understand your lifestyle, needs, and the motivations behind your unique remodeling project. This relaxed and informative session lays the groundwork for your remodel.

Experience our wide array of materials, finishes, and displays for inspiration
Digital presentation of our process, portfolio, and investment ranges
Honest conversation about your goals, style preferences, and budget window
Clear next steps for moving into the Discovery Phase with confidence
Discovery & Initial Site Measurement

Next, we start by bringing the conversation to your home. This phase is about gathering the details we need to start shaping your project. We’ll take photos, measurements, discuss layout possibilities, and present simple floor plan options to refine the direction back in the showroom. At the showroom, we’ll discuss:

Preliminary finishes and product ideas introduced
One or two simple design presentations with options that fit your budget window
A narrowed, more accurate investment range that sets the stage for design development
Design, Renderings & Detailed Selections

With the foundation in place, we dive into design. This is where your project comes to life through drawings, 3D renderings, and detailed selections. Our designers work closely with you through multiple meetings to refine layouts, perfect finishes, and confirm every detail before construction.

Guided selection meetings for cabinetry, countertops, flooring, fixtures, and more
Fully rendered drawings and 3D visualizations of your remodel
Multiple design review and revision sessions to fine-tune your vision
A fixed-price proposal so you know exactly what to expect before moving forward
Work Contract Acceptance & Signing

When you are feeling confident about the design and pricing and ready to proceed, it’s time to discuss the final details! The contract signing marks the official transition from planning to production, giving you a clear roadmap for the next phase.

Review and acceptance of the Construction Agreement
Signing of final design documents
Clear outline of next steps, including handoff to our production team during an in-home review.
Confidence that every detail is locked in before construction begins
Production, In-Home Project Construction

This is where vision becomes reality. Before construction starts, we’ll host an in-home project review so you can meet the production team, walk through the plan, and confirm final details. From there, construction begins—executed with precision, communication, and expert craftsmanship.

Ordering and review of all materials, products, and custom pieces
In-Home Project Review with your Project Manager to answer questions
Careful scheduling, pre-construction planning, and blueprint verification
Professional construction with ongoing site visits and communication
Project Completion & Enjoyment

The final step is all about celebrating your new space and making sure every detail is perfect. We’ll complete a thorough walkthrough with you, resolve any punch-list items, and capture professional photos of your finished remodel.

Final walkthrough to confirm your remodel meets expectations
Punch-list completion to ensure flawless results
Professional photography of your finished space
Follow-up support from the Premier team, beyond the project
Ready to Start Planning Your Remodel?
If you’re ready to start exploring possibilities for your home, our team is here to guide you through the next step.

BATHROOM REMODELING
Bathroom Remodeling in Mesa & Scottsdale, AZ
REQUEST CONSULTATION
A Better Way To Remodel Your Bathroom

A bathroom remodel should feel exciting, not overwhelming.

With the right structure, the process becomes organized, collaborative, and intentional. Decisions are made with clarity. Timelines are realistic. Craftsmanship is never rushed.

At Premier Design-Build-Remodel, we approach bathroom remodeling differently. As a true design-build firm serving Mesa, Scottsdale, and the East Valley, we bring design, planning, construction, and long-term support together under one roof; creating a smoother experience from concept to completion. If you are planning a bathroom remodel in Mesa, AZ, start at our Mesa showroom on Baseline Rd.

When one coordinated team guides the entire project, homeowners gain confidence at every stage.

Bathroom Remodeling Built Around Clarity And Craftsmanship
Design First, Not Demolition First

Every successful remodel begins with thoughtful planning. We take time to understand how you use your space, what isn’t working, and what would elevate your daily routine. Layout refinement, storage optimization, and guided material selections happen before construction begins; not during it.

One Coordinated Team

Designers, project managers, and installers work together from day one. There are no disconnected vendors and no confusion about responsibility. Communication stays streamlined, and each stage builds logically on the last.

Precision Execution

From tile alignment to custom cabinetry installation, details matter. Our team prioritizes craftsmanship, clean job sites, and respectful in-home practices; ensuring the finished space reflects both quality and care.

Luxury Bathroom Remodeling

For many homeowners in Mesa and Scottsdale, a bathroom remodel is about more than updating finishes; it’s about creating a personal retreat.

Luxury bathroom remodeling may include:

Custom walk-in showers with frameless glass
Freestanding soaking tubs
Designer lighting and layered illumination
Custom vanities with integrated storage
Premium tile and stone surfaces
Steam showers and heated floor systems
Luxurious custom closet solutions

Every element is selected with longevity and cohesion in mind. The result is a space that feels refined, functional, and tailored to your lifestyle.

Small Bathroom Remodel Ideas & Solutions

A smaller footprint doesn’t limit potential; it just requires smarter design.

For compact bathrooms, we focus on:

Space-saving layout adjustments
Walk-in shower conversions
Vertical storage solutions
Floating vanities for visual openness
Strategic lighting to enhance dimension
Creative storage solutions

Through careful planning and material selection, even a modestly sized bathroom can feel elevated and efficient.

Shower & Tub Remodeling Options

Whether you’re replacing an outdated tub, converting to a walk-in shower, or upgrading both, we tailor the design to your goals.

Common upgrades include:

Tub-to-shower conversions
Custom tile selections and layouts
Built-in niches and bench seating
High-performance shower possibilities
Accessibility-focused enhancements

Every shower and tub installation is coordinated within the full remodeling plan; ensuring structural integrity, waterproofing precision, and long-term durability.

How Much Does A Bathroom Remodel Cost?

Bathroom remodeling costs vary based on scope, design complexity, and finish selections. In Mesa, Scottsdale, and throughout the Phoenix metro area, investment ranges depend less on square footage alone and more on customization level and behind-the-wall adjustments.

Rather than providing rough estimates upfront, Premier follows a structured design-build process to clarify layout, materials, and scope before construction begins. This allows us to provide realistic investment guidance tailored to your home.

What Impacts The Cost Of A Bathroom Remodel?
Layout modifications or plumbing relocation
Custom tile showers and specialty fixtures
Cabinetry design and storage solutions
Material quality and brand selection
Structural or system updates in older homes

During your consultation, we walk through scope-based pricing, timeline expectations, and material allowances; ensuring clarity before any work begins.

Our goal is transparency, not surprises.

Our 6-Step Bathroom Remodeling Process
Complimentary Consultation
Begin with a relaxed consultation in our Mesa or Scottsdale showroom. We discuss goals, explore materials, and outline what your remodeling journey will look like. You’ll leave with clarity on next steps.
Discovery & Measurement
We visit your home to take measurements, document existing conditions, and evaluate layout opportunities. This phase helps narrow scope and establish a realistic investment range.
Design & Renderings
Detailed plans, 3D renderings, and curated material selections bring your vision into focus. Every decision is finalized before construction begins, ensuring alignment and confidence.
Contract Signing
Once design and scope are approved, we formalize the agreement and lock in scheduling. This step transitions your project from planning into production.
Construction Work
Before construction begins, we review the plan in your home with the production team. From there, coordinated scheduling and precise craftsmanship guide the build phase.
Project Completion
We complete a final walkthrough, confirm every detail meets expectations, and provide ongoing support. Your remodeled bathroom is delivered with clarity and care.
Is A Design-Build Bathroom Remodel Right For You?
A Great Fit If You:
Want a fully managed, start-to-finish experience
Value craftsmanship and premium finishes
Prefer making selections in a professional showroom setting
Plan to invest in your home long-term
Not The Right Fit If You:
Are looking for the lowest bid available
Prefer to coordinate separate contractors yourself
Need a quick cosmetic update rather than a structured remodel

KITCHEN REMODELING
Kitchen Remodeling in Mesa & Scottsdale, AZ
REQUEST CONSULTATION

The kitchen is where mornings begin, guests gather, and routines unfold. When layout, storage, and flow are misaligned, the entire home feels it.

A successful kitchen remodel isn’t just about new cabinets or countertops. It’s about redefining how your space functions; improving workflow, opening sightlines, increasing storage efficiency, and creating a layout that supports how you actually live.

At Premier Design-Build-Remodel, we approach kitchen remodeling with structure and intention. Serving Mesa, Scottsdale, and the East Valley, our design-build model brings planning, material selection, and construction under one roof;  ensuring your new kitchen performs as beautifully as it looks. If you are planning a kitchen remodel in Mesa, AZ, start at our Mesa showroom on Baseline Rd.

Professional Kitchen Design Built Around Function And Flow

Before selecting finishes, we solve layout.

We craft solutions that fit your lifestyle for today and tomorrow by evaluating:

Traffic patterns and circulation space
Appliance placement and efficiency
Island positioning and seating integration
Storage capacity and accessibility
Lighting layers for task and ambiance

Through thoughtful planning and guided showroom selections, your kitchen remodel becomes both practical and refined.

When design decisions are made early and collaboratively, construction moves forward without unnecessary surprises.

Custom Cabinetry & Smart Storage Solutions

Cabinetry defines both form and function.

Whether you prefer contemporary minimalism or timeless craftsmanship, we design cabinetry systems that maximize usability and organization.

Options may include:

Custom-built cabinetry
Deep drawer storage
Custom storage solutions designed for your family’s needs
Pull-out pantry systems
Integrated trash and recycling solutions
Floor-to-ceiling storage walls

Every element is selected for durability, alignment, and long-term performance.

Open-Concept & Structural Kitchen Transformations

Many kitchen remodels extend beyond finishes and into structural change.

For homeowners seeking a more connected living space, we often explore:

Wall removal for open-concept layouts
Structural beam integration
Kitchen-to-living reconfiguration
Expanded island footprints
Natural light enhancement

These changes require careful planning, permitting, and engineering; all managed within our structured design-build process.

Luxury Kitchen Remodeling

For those seeking elevated design, luxury kitchen remodeling focuses on materials, scale, and detail.

Premium upgrades may include:

Oversized islands with waterfall edges
Professional-grade appliances
Statement lighting installations
Custom range hoods
High-end stone countertops
Integrated smart-home features

The result is a kitchen that balances visual impact with lasting performance.

How Much Does A Kitchen Remodel Cost?

Kitchen remodeling investment depends heavily on cabinetry level, structural changes, appliance selection, and finish materials. In Mesa, Scottsdale, and throughout the Phoenix metro area, customization plays a significant role in overall cost.

Rather than offering generalized estimates, Premier clarifies scope through a structured design phase before construction begins. This allows us to provide realistic investment guidance aligned with your goals.

What Impacts Kitchen Remodel Cost?
Cabinetry customization and materials
Countertop selection
Appliance upgrades
Structural modifications
Electrical and plumbing adjustments
Lighting design complexity

During your consultation, we outline scope-based pricing, material allowances, and timeline expectations so you can move forward confidently.

Transparency is part of the process; not an afterthought.

Our 6-Step Kitchen Remodeling Process
Complimentary Consultation
Meet with our design team in Mesa or Scottsdale to discuss goals, layout challenges, and vision. Explore materials and outline next steps.
Discovery & Measurement
We visit your home to measure and document existing conditions while evaluating layout opportunities. Scope and investment range are refined.
Design & Renderings
Detailed drawings, renderings, and curated material selections are developed. A fixed-price construction agreement is prepared.
Contract Signing
Scope, scheduling, and materials are finalized. Your project transitions into production.
Construction Work
An in-home project review is completed before construction begins. Our coordinated team manages scheduling, craftsmanship, and quality control.
Project Completion
We conduct a final walkthrough, confirm details, and provide long-term support.
Is A Design-Build Kitchen Remodel Right For You?
A Great Fit If You:
Want a fully managed remodeling experience
Value custom cabinetry and premium materials
Prefer structured planning before construction
Plan to stay in your home long-term
Not The Right Fit If You:
Are searching for the lowest bid available
Prefer managing multiple contractors independently
Need only surface-level updates

WHOLE HOME REMODELING
Whole Home Remodeling in Mesa & Scottsdale, AZ
REQUEST CONSULTATION

A whole home remodel isn’t about updating a space.

It’s about redefining how your home supports your life. Consider your needs not only for now, but for what the future holds. This includes creating functional spaces for a growing family, or dedicated rooms for Mom and Dad when they move in.

Whether your goal is improving flow, modernizing outdated finishes, increasing functionality, or creating design continuity throughout the home, a comprehensive remodel requires vision and structure.

At Premier Design-Build-Remodel, we help homeowners in Mesa, Scottsdale, and throughout the East Valley transform their homes with clarity and coordination. Our integrated design-build approach ensures that every room works together; architecturally, visually, and functionally.

When the entire home is considered at once, the result feels intentional, not pieced together.

Unified Design. Cohesive Results.

One of the greatest advantages of whole home remodeling is continuity.

Instead of remodeling room by room over time, we create a unified design plan that considers:

Layout transitions between spaces
Consistent flooring and material palettes
Lighting strategy throughout the home
Architectural details and trim alignment
Sightlines and natural light flow

This holistic approach prevents design fragmentation and creates a seamless living environment.

Structural Reconfiguration & Space Optimization

Whole home remodeling often includes structural improvements that dramatically enhance livability.

Depending on your goals, this may involve:

Removing walls for open-concept layouts
Reconfiguring room placements
Expanding primary suites
Relocating kitchens or bathrooms
Updating outdated floor plans

These changes require careful engineering, permitting, and phased construction planning; all managed within our structured process.

Modernization & Systems Upgrades

In older homes, cosmetic updates alone aren’t enough.

A whole home remodel may include:

Electrical panel upgrades
Plumbing system modernization
Energy-efficient window replacements
Improved insulation
HVAC improvements
Smart home integration

Addressing these systems during a comprehensive remodel increases long-term efficiency and performance.

Whole Home Remodeling Investment

Because whole home remodeling varies significantly in scope, investment depends on structural modifications, material selections, and systems upgrades.

Rather than offering broad estimates, we guide clients through a structured planning phase to define:

Scope priorities
Phasing options (if needed)
Budget alignment
Timeline expectations

By clarifying design and construction details before work begins, we help homeowners move forward with realistic expectations and confidence.

Our 6-Step Whole Home Remodeling Process
Complimentary Consultation
We meet in our Mesa or Scottsdale showroom to discuss your vision, goals, and overall home transformation priorities.
Discovery & Measurement
Our team visits your home to gather measurements, document existing conditions, and evaluate layout possibilities.
Design & Renderings
We develop detailed drawings, renderings, and coordinated material selections that reflect a unified home-wide design.
Contract Signing
Scope, budget, and scheduling are finalized. The project transitions into production planning.
Construction Work
Construction begins with coordinated scheduling and structured oversight. Because this involves multiple spaces, sequencing is carefully managed.
Project Completion
A comprehensive walkthrough ensures every room meets expectations and quality standards before project closeout.
Is Whole Home Remodeling Right For You?
A Great Fit If You:
Want cohesive design throughout your home
Plan to stay long-term
Prefer addressing structural and aesthetic updates simultaneously
Value a professionally managed, phased approach
Not The Right Fit If You:
Only need a single room update
Prefer remodeling gradually over many years
Are seeking minor cosmetic changes only
